## Hands-on workshop: uncertainty quantification and sensitivity analysis in cardiovascular modelling

**Leif Rune Hellevik**  
NTNU / University of Michigan  
**June 1, 2026 • 12:30–3:30 pm • NCRC, University of Michigan**  
Optional discussion / Q&A until 4:00 pm

To make the workshop as interactive and productive as possible, we ask participants to complete a small amount of preparation beforehand.

Estimated preparation time: **30–45 minutes**.

## Required preparation

### Preliminaries notebook

Please work through the preliminaries notebook before the workshop.

The goal is not to master all details beforehand, but to:

- become familiar with running notebook cells
- verify that your notebook environment works properly
- refresh key statistical concepts used during the workshop:
  - expectation and variance
  - conditional expectation
  - variance decomposition  


Access:  
Google Colab (recommended):  [Open preliminaries.ipynb in Colab](https://colab.research.google.com/github/lrhgit/uqsa2025/blob/main/preliminaries.ipynb).  
GitHub / local Jupyter: 
[preliminaries.ipynb on GitHub](https://github.com/lrhgit/uqsa2025/blob/main/preliminaries.ipynb)

## Optional preview

### Interactive Sobol G* notebook

Participants who would like a short optional preview of the workshop themes may also explore the interactive Sobol G* notebook.

This notebook provides intuition for:

- first-order Sobol sensitivity indices
- total-effect sensitivity indices
- interaction effects
- factor importance

The notebook will be used interactively during the workshop.  

Access:

Google Colab: 
[Open gstar_function.ipynb in Colab](https://colab.research.google.com/github/lrhgit/uqsa2025/blob/main/gstar_function.ipynb)

GitHub / local Jupyter: 
[gstar_function.ipynb on GitHub](https://github.com/lrhgit/uqsa2025/blob/main/gstar_function.ipynb)


## Overview of the workshop
For participants who would like an overview of the workshop structure, the full workshop agenda is available [here](workshop.html).


## Running the notebooks

The workshop notebooks are intended to be runnable directly in **Google Colab**, allowing participants to work in a browser without needing a local Python installation.

Benefits of this approach include:

- no local software installation required
- no dependency management
- a common environment for all participants
- easier troubleshooting during the workshop

Participants who prefer working locally in Jupyter can also download the notebooks from GitHub and install dependencies using `requirements.txt`.

For local installation:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/lrhgit/uqsa2025.git
cd uqsa2025
pip install -r requirements.txt
jupyter lab
```
